# Firas Ridene

> AI engineer based in Tunis, Tunisia, specialized in generative AI and multi-agent systems. Builds voice agents, automation pipelines, and multi-agent platforms that ship to production.

Firas Ridene is a computer science engineering student at Esprit (Tunis) and an AI engineer building agent systems that do real work: voice agents that answer phones, an agent team that ships code, and pipelines that cut manual prospecting time by up to 80%. He designs multi-agent systems end-to-end and picks the stack per problem, not per habit.

## Experience

- Freelance Software Engineer — B2B SaaS startup, Paris (remote), Mar 2026–present: contributes to a multi-tenant AI sales-outreach platform; built an AI agent system that autonomously qualifies prospects and generates personalized outreach at scale.
- End-of-Studies Intern — Agile4UX, Feb–Jul 2026: designed a multi-tenant platform for building and deploying AI voice agents across phone, chat, and WhatsApp, with real-time voice, knowledge retrieval, and human handoff at sub-second latency.
- AI Automation Intern — Agile4ux, 2025: designed a multi-agent system to research, qualify, and analyze prospects; cut manual prospecting time by ~80%.
- Data Platform Development Intern — Designet, 2024: built a lead-generation platform from Google Maps data with filterable criteria and CSV export.

## Selected projects

- VocaFlow — multi-tenant platform for building and deploying AI voice agents across phone, chat, and WhatsApp. https://github.com/RideneFiras/Vocaflow
- 8-Agent Dev Team — a full software team staffed by 8 specialized Claude Code agents (PM, Frontend, Backend, AI, DevOps, QA, Test, Docs); shipped 170+ GitHub issues and 726 automated tests across a ~40,000-line codebase in about 4 weeks. https://github.com/RideneFiras/ClaudeCodeTeam
- Multi-Agent Prospecting System — agents that research, qualify, and analyze prospects, then write the outreach and the reports.
- Content Creation Automation — automated research, generation, and publication of Facebook content, with a human checkpoint before anything ships.
- Recruitment Automation System — four interconnected pipelines covering candidate intake, AI scoring, ATS sync, and lead generation.
- TT Assistant — multilingual (Arabic, French, English, Tunisian dialect) voice + text chatbot for Tunisie Telecom; 3rd place at the AI for CSR Hackathon. https://github.com/RideneFiras/ChatbotTT
- Airline Customer Service Assistant — GenAI capstone (Kaggle x Google): structured-dialogue assistant with RAG over a dedicated knowledge base. https://github.com/RideneFiras/KagglexGoogle
- Pedagog'IA — social platform for Tunisian teachers with AI generation of fiches, quizzes, and exercises. https://github.com/RideneFiras/PedagogIA
- 5G Throughput Prediction — MLOps pipeline comparing 300+ models on Azure ML, explainable with SHAP, monitored with Elasticsearch/Kibana. https://github.com/RideneFiras/QosMLOPS
- Industrial Anomaly Detection — CNN autoencoder trained only on defect-free images, flags visual defects by reconstruction error; cut manual inspection time by 70%. https://github.com/RideneFiras/Anomaly_detection
- Odoo Integrations — Odoo CRM wired into a multi-agent prospecting system, plus a facial-recognition attendance module.
- LeadGenMAP — platform that generates qualified leads from Google Maps with filterable criteria and CSV export. https://github.com/RideneFiras/LeadGenMAP
- n8n Workflow Library — public collection of the n8n workflows behind his automation work, packaged for reuse. https://github.com/RideneFiras/Myn8nWorkflows
